title: Grateful Dead Live at Hilton Hotel on 1969-03-15

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the rare Black & White Ball set with a smoking Dark Star and debut Hard to Handle, offering solid but occasionally uneven audio.
ai_review.review: The recording preserves a historically significant Black & White Ball performance, highlighted by an epic Dark Star that flows into St. Stephen, The Eleven and Turn On Your Lovelight, plus the first ever rendition of Hard to Handle. While many listeners praise the mix and Jerry Garcia’s vivid guitar tone, a few note occasional audio glitches and a sloppy opening of Hard to Handle, making the overall listening experience good but not flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical moments (especially Dark Star) and deem the soundboard mix decent, but several low‑mid ratings point to audio inconsistencies and a rough Hard to Handle start, yielding an overall good rating with mixed confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard mix praised by several reviewers; some describe it as a "train wreck" or note minor drop‑outs, but overall considered listenable with only occasional issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial first set is missing some songs, but the second half delivers a strong sequence of Dark Star into St. Stephen, The Eleven and Turn On Your Lovelight; overall flow is praised despite incomplete early material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's tone is highlighted as vivid and alive; he plays his Gibson SG with a powerful presence throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig Pen contributes vocals and organ, adding an enjoyable texture noted by reviewers.
